items.title: July 31, 1992: Charles Barkley finishes with 30 PTS (12-14 FG)/8 REB/4 STL in 19 minutes of Team USA's 127-83 preliminary round win over Brazil at the Olympics in Barcelona.
items.author: NBA Cobwebs
items.body_excerpt:
July 31, 1992: Charles Barkley finishes with 30 PTS (12-14 FG)/8 REB/4 STL in 19 minutes of Team USA's 127-83 preliminary round win over Brazil at the Olympics in Barcelona.

Chris Mullin scored 19 PTS and Clyde Drexler added 10 AST for the “Dream Team,” which improved to 4-0.
